question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: based on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.

 
 
• Taken after: To look or behave like an older relative. (पुराने रिश्तेदार की तरह दिखना या व्यवहार करना)
 
• Held on: To tell someone to wait or stop. (किसी को प्रतीक्षा करने या रुकने के लिए कहना)
 
• Given in: To stop competing or arguing and accept defeat. (प्रतिस्पर्धा या बहस करना बंद करें और हार मान लें)
 
• Based on: Use ideas or facts when doing something. (कुछ करते समय विचारों या तथ्यों का उपयोग करें)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "based on" is the most appropriate option.
 
• The implied meaning of the sentence is: Fossils are the foundation for everything we know about non-avian animals.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Complete passage: *Everything we know about non-avian dinosaurs is **based on (1)__** fossils, which include bones, teeth, footprints, tracks, eggs, and skin impressions. For centuries, people throughout the world have ________ (2) amazing fossilized bones and footprints. Early finds inspired_______ (3) and fairy tales, and people ________ (4) that these bones belonged to________ (5) or huge monsters.*

43:Td08,

The correct answer is: discovered.
